mechanism: Pantoprazole may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of oxybutynin, increasing oxybutynin levels and anticholinergic effects; additive anticholinergic effects may occur as pantoprazole has minor anticholinergic properties.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic adverse effects (dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, confusion); consider dose adjustment of oxybutynin or alternative PPI if effects are excessive.
